key.name: laccy-toggle-shortcut
key.description: Opens the clipboard history popup, or closes it when it is open.

key.name: paste-automatically
key.description: Also paste into the focused app after picking an item, instead of only copying it. Alt+Enter does the opposite.

key.name: paste-without-formatting
key.description: Pick text items as plain text, without formatting like bold or links. Alt+Shift+Enter does the opposite.

key.name: history-size
key.description: Number of unpinned items kept in history. Pinned items are always kept.

key.name: ignored-apps
key.description: Desktop app IDs whose copies are never recorded, e.g. org.keepassxc.KeePassXC.desktop.

key.name: ignored-patterns
key.description: Regular expressions; text and file copies matching any of them are never recorded. Case-sensitive unless a pattern starts with (?i).

key.name: paused
key.description: While on, copies are not recorded. Alt-click the top bar icon to toggle it.

key.name: record-text
key.description: Record copied text.

key.name: record-images
key.description: Record copied images.

key.name: record-files
key.description: Record copied files.

key.name: search-mode
key.description: How the popup matches what you type. "exact" matches each word as written; "fuzzy" also matches its letters in order with gaps, so "gco" finds "git checkout"; "regex" matches a regular expression, ignoring case.

key.name: sort-by
key.description: The order of unpinned items: most recently copied first, most recently first copied first, or most copied first. Pinned items always stay at the top.

key.name: highlight-matches
key.description: How the popup marks the text a search matched.

key.name: show-special-symbols
key.description: Shows leading and trailing spaces as ·, line breaks as ⏎ and tabs as ⇥ in the popup.

key.name: show-color-swatches
key.description: Shows a small square of the color next to items that are a hex color code, like #3584e4.

key.name: show-app-icons
key.description: Shows the icon of the app each item was copied from.

key.name: preview-automatically
key.description: Shows the selected item in full next to the list once the selection rests for preview-delay milliseconds. Ctrl+Space always toggles it.

key.name: preview-delay
key.description: Milliseconds the selection has to rest before the preview opens automatically.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Shows a Laccy icon in the top bar. Click it to open the clipboard history; right-click it for more options.

key.name: show-latest-copy
key.summary: Show latest copy in top bar
key.description: Shows the start of the most recently copied unpinned item next to the top bar icon.

key.name: max-item-bytes
key.description: Text and file copies larger than this many bytes are not recorded.

key.name: max-image-bytes
key.description: Copied images larger than this many bytes are not recorded.
